data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 379.4m at 1 January 2021 and closing gross claims outstanding of GBP 361.9m at 31 December 2021. Analysis of the gross claims development table (UW years 2013-2019) indicates a net prior-year release of approximately GBP 24.0m (about 6.3% of opening gross reserves), driven primarily by favourable claims development across multiple older underwriting years. The underwriting result for 2021 was nevertheless negatively affected by several large 2021 catastrophe events (Hurricane Ida, European Floods and Winterstorm Uri) which increased current-year losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the gross claims development table (cumulative incurred triangle) by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for UW years 2013-2019 (see page 101). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was provided; used triangle method (per instructions). Detailed 2021 regulatory segmental premium breakdown was not clearly extractable from the notes; gross written premium for 2021 taken from Chairman's statement. Where exact gross or LOB-level reserve movements were not provided, amounts are left null.
